title: Vector and Colony
author: P. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Ivo Iversen, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
